how: Atlanta Lacrosse League runs adult leagues alongside youth programs at Sandy Springs fields such as Hammond Park.
Atlanta Ballet offers drop-in adult tap classes for all ability levels at its Buckhead and other studios.
venue: Atlanta Ballet Centre for Dance Education

how: Occasional bookbinding workshops are held at venues such as Scraplanta in Tucker and Piedmont Park Community Center, but no permanent course was confirmed.
Ichiyo Ikebana of Atlanta teaches classes in Old Fourth Ward and Ikebana International Atlanta Chapter 265 and Atlanta Botanical Garden also run workshops.
A local architect-artist led an urban sketching outing in Little Five Points listed by Midtown Atlanta; no standing chapter page was found.
venue: Urban sketching outing at Variety Playhouse

how: Wildfire Paintball in Snellville runs an indoor speedball and hyperball arena with rentals; outdoor fields operate in Roswell/Alpharetta, Conyers and Acworth.
The Atlanta Go Club held tournaments with Chinese and Korean community groups at Oriental Chess in Duluth in 2012; current activity was not confirmed.
Georgia State University's Creative Media Industries Institute hosts an annual Global Game Jam site in downtown Atlanta open to anyone 18 or older, with PCs and Unity/Unreal provided.
ScratchOutLoud is an Atlanta all-vinyl DJ school offering lessons and workshops for a range of skill levels.
The Atlanta Community Symphony Orchestra and the volunteer Atlanta Philharmonic Orchestra rehearse weekly for non-professional players.
Aparna's Dance Academy has taught Kathak, Bollywood and Indian folk dance in metro Atlanta since 2000 and stages an annual Kathak showcase at Georgia Tech's Ferst Center.
IBM Ring 9 (Georgia Magic Club) is an 85-year-old chapter of the International Brotherhood of Magicians with about 90 members, alongside a local Society of American Magicians chapter.
Meetup groups such as Posh Poker Group (Texas Hold'em at Mazzy's in Milton and Roswell) and The Four Suit Poker League run freeroll social poker in the Atlanta area.
The Atlanta Korean Language Meetup Group runs weekly Saturday Korean-English language exchange sessions for all levels.
Dozens of Meetup book clubs meet across the metro, including Books by the Beltline, Atlanta Nonfiction Book Club and Decatur Women's Book Club.
venue: Books by the Beltline Book Club

how: District 213 Toastmasters clubs (Village Speakers, Clarkston Community, Northwords) hold public-speaking meetings listed on Meetup; competitive debate leagues were not confirmed.
Volunteer mornings at the Food4Lives Community Garden recur on Sundays, listed through the Atlanta Vegetarian & Vegan Meetup group.
Many peer support groups meet in the metro, such as Decatur Grief Walks, Alpharetta Prostate Cancer Support Group and ASCA-Atlanta.
Ladies That UX Atlanta hosts speed-mentoring sessions and Toastmasters clubs provide peer mentoring; no dedicated youth-mentoring programme was confirmed.
Acworth Cobb Dragon Boat Club holds competitive practices on Lake Acworth, and Dragon Boat Atlanta paddles at Lake Lanier, with the annual Atlanta Hong Kong Dragon Boat Festival there.
Atlanta Parkour runs coach-led fundamentals to advanced classes, open gym and a family class for ages 7 to 60, and LEAP Parkour teaches mobile classes around the metro.
Wakeboard lessons and boat sessions are offered on Lake Lanier (Georgia Wakeboard Lessons, Festive Water), roughly 65 km from the centre.
Cable wakeboard parks serve the metro: Wake the Lake on Lake Lanier and Terminus Wake Park in Cartersville, both outside the 30 km radius; sources are dated 2013-2014.
Lake Lanier Water Ski Camp has taught water skiing with week-long sessions and private lessons since 1985, about 65 km north of the centre.
A long-running windsurfing club meets monthly and sails at Van Pugh Park on Lake Lanier, with lessons and rentals from Windsense in Flowery Branch.
ASA-certified sailing instruction is available at Lanier Sailing Academy on Lake Lanier, about 65 km from the centre.
Balloon Atlanta in Woodstock flies passenger rides year-round across the metro, and tethered balloon rides run at Piedmont Park's Balloon Glow.
Atlanta Airsoft Inc operates a 15,000 sq ft indoor field with a retail store, and Georgia Paintball & Airsoft offers open play and scenario games.
Occasional hands-on cheesemaking classes have been run in Atlanta, for example by Oli+Ve and Cultured South (vegan cashew cheese); no permanent course was confirmed.
The Atlanta Kookaburras, founded in 1998, field men's and women's teams in the United States Australian Football League.
Pool halls such as Red Fox Billiards Club, Morgan Falls Billiards and Mr Cue's Billiards II host league play (APA/TAP) and table rentals across the metro.
Atlanta Regional Polo Center runs matches and a polo school at Vinings from May to October and a Tyrone arena from November to April.
Netball America ran a free youth netball programme at Redan Recreation Center in Lithonia (DeKalb County) in 2021 and 2023; no adult league was confirmed.
venue: Netball America at Redan Recreation Center

how: Jeju Sauna & Spa in Duluth is a 24-hour Korean-style bathhouse with mineral baths and themed saunas, and Gangnam Sauna operates a similar bathhouse in Atlanta.
The Atlanta Botanical Garden's Kendeda Canopy Walk is a 600-foot skywalk reaching into the treetops of the garden's woodland.
